posts.text:
I was proud to honor the life of Laken by ushering the Laken Riley Act through the Senate and getting it enacted into law. It strengthened our immigration laws by requiring the detention of illegal aliens who - like Laken’s killer - commit theft offenses, or several other categories of offenses, so that they can’t reoffend and commit further crimes. 

Since then, more than 43,000 criminal illegal aliens have been taken off our streets, with nearly 30,000 already deported.

But there’s still more
